payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Brain, Gaylene, Harmony, Logan, Milly, Ronna

payload.content: Harmony planning: my cheapest feasible options are ISSUE-0001::triage (cost 5.77), ISSUE-0001::review/docs (7.21), ISSUE-0001::test (10.70). Infrastructure tasks are very costly for me. Tentative preference: claim ISSUE-0001::triage unless others have substantially better fit; otherwise I can take ISSUE-0001::review or ::docs. Please share intended picks to avoid duplicates.

Milly planning (iter 1): my cheapest feasible task is ISSUE-0001::triage at cost 7.99. Next best are ISSUE-0001::review and ISSUE-0001::docs, both 9.99. ISSUE-0001::test is 13.99; infrastructure tasks are very expensive for me (20+). Since Harmony reported a better cost on ISSUE-0001::triage (5.77), I suggest Harmony take triage. I can tentatively cover ISSUE-0001::review or ISSUE-0001::docs if those remain unclaimed by lower-cost agents. Please share intended picks so we avoid duplicates and keep infra for anyone with better fit.

Infrastructure tasks are prohibitively expensive for me (20+). Compared with reported costs so far, I appear to be the lowest-cost agent yet on ISSUE-0001 tasks. Tentative recommendation: I take ISSUE-0001::triage in execution; Harmony or Milly can shift to ISSUE-0001::review / ::docs if no one cheaper appears. If someone has lower cost than 3.09 on triage, please say so and I can pivot to review/docs.

Brain planning iter 1: I have 5.0h availability and strong infrastructure fit. My cheapest feasible tasks are ISSUE-0002::review cost 2.15, ISSUE-0002::test cost 3.01, ISSUE-0002::implement cost 4.30. Documentation tasks are much worse for me (ISSUE-0001::triage 7.95, ::review/docs 9.93, ::test 14.51, ::implement 22.87). Tentative recommendation: I should take an infrastructure task, preferably ISSUE-0002::review as my current lowest-cost option, leaving ISSUE-0001 tasks to Logan/Harmony/Milly who have much better fit. If someone else has even lower cost on ISSUE-0002::review, please say so; otherwise I plan to claim ISSUE-0002::review in execution.

Ronna planning iter 1: availability 7.0h, strong data-science fit (0.85). My private costs: ISSUE-0001::triage 6.11, ::review 7.64, ::docs 7.64, ::test 10.70, ::implement 16.28. Based on visible reports, Logan is cheapest on ISSUE-0001::triage (3.09) and Brain is cheapest on ISSUE-0002::review (2.15). Tentative recommendation: Logan take ISSUE-0001::triage, Brain take ISSUE-0002::review. I can cover ISSUE-0001::review or ISSUE-0001::docs if still needed, but should defer to any lower-cost agent. Please share remaining intended picks so we can spread across distinct tasks and maximize completed tasks. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Milly planning iter 1 update: given shared costs, current efficient spread seems Brain->ISSUE-0002::review (2.15), Logan->ISSUE-0001::triage (3.09), Harmony->ISSUE-0001::review (7.21).
